explication: XWiki Platform is a runtime wiki platform for applications. A typical interaction reaches the wiki through its document-facing API, which exposes document objects and their properties; query services provide a separate route to retrieve data, while authentication and entity references support runtime identity and addressing. The supplied tree and excerpts cover only selected modules of this large platform, so the graph focuses on those evidenced areas rather than inferring connections among the many other listed services.
